description: Rejects numeric repository read limits and unbounded Firestore collection reads outside the canonical ReadLimitPolicy and reviewed-exception contracts.

rules.title: Repository read limits use one reviewed surface policy
rules.instruction: Growing repository reads use a reviewed ReadLimitPolicy value plus an opaque cursor path. Numeric limit and take literals must not be reintroduced in repository code, and bounded-set exceptions must remain explicit in data_contracts.md.
